subject: art-design
title: Form & 3D Objects
welcome_lead: Cubes, spheres and cones — the 3D family.
meta_desc: KS3 form: 3D shapes, illusion of form, basic forms.
final_note: Every solid object is built from basic forms.

concepts.def: 3D form with circular base and point.
3D form with flat base and pointed top.

walkthroughs.body_html: The five basic forms are cube, sphere, cylinder, cone and pyramid. A house is a cube and a triangular prism; a tree is a sphere on a cylinder.
Start with a circle. Add a curved horizon line round the back. Shade darker on the side away from the light, lighter on the side facing it. Now it reads as a sphere.
Walk around your room: lamp shade (cone), can (cylinder), book (cube), apple (sphere). Practice drawing these solids and you can draw anything.
